parsed.name: Tron1 里程计桥接节点
parsed.description: 这是一个非实体的软件组件：ROS2 节点，用于把 Tron1 的 WebSocket 里程计数据转换并发布为 ROS2 的 /odom 话题消息，供机器人定位、导航与状态集成使用。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component: a ROS2 node that converts Tron1 odometry data from WebSocket into ROS2 /odom topic messages for robot localization, navigation, and system integration.

actions.description: 在 WebSocket 连接建立后发送启用里程计数据流的请求。
actions.description_en: Send a request to enable odometry streaming after the WebSocket connection is established.

actions.description: 接收 WebSocket 消息并处理收到的里程计相关数据。
actions.description_en: Receive WebSocket messages and process incoming odometry-related data.

actions.description: 处理 WebSocket 通信过程中发生的错误。
actions.description_en: Handle errors that occur during WebSocket communication.

actions.description: 处理 WebSocket 连接关闭事件。
actions.description_en: Handle the WebSocket connection close event.

actions.description: 发送启用或禁用里程计数据流的请求。
actions.description_en: Send a request to enable or disable odometry streaming.

actions.description: 将 WebSocket 里程计数据转换为 ROS2 Odometry 消息并发布。
actions.description_en: Convert WebSocket odometry data into a ROS2 Odometry message and publish it.

actions.description: 运行带重连机制的 WebSocket 主循环。
actions.description_en: Run the main WebSocket loop with reconnection handling.

actions.description: 在节点关闭时禁用里程计数据流并清理资源。
actions.description_en: Disable odometry streaming and clean up resources when the node shuts down.
